sources.entry: Alfresco Community Edition - The open source Enterprise Content Management software that handles any type of content, allowing users to easily share and collaborate on content. (Source Code) LGPL-3.0 Java

summary.one_liner: Source repository for the Java server libraries (core, data model, repository, remote API) behind Alfresco Community Edition, an open source enterprise content management system.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes four Maven-packaged libraries: Alfresco Core (helpers, utilities, canned query interfaces, encryption classes), Alfresco Data Model (dictionary, repository and search service interfaces, data type models, parsers), Alfresco Repository (DAOs and SQL scripts, service implementations, utilities), and Alfresco Remote API (REST API framework, WebScript implementations including V1 REST APIs, OpenCMIS implementations). It explains how to pull these artifacts from the Alfresco Maven repository as dependencies, including a combined content-services-community WAR. Branches correspond to ACS releases, with master holding unreleased code and release/x.N branches gathering service pack fixes. The README points to a separate development Tomcat/Docker guide for trying out changes. Development setup details are not included in the README itself.
use_cases: build or extend Alfresco Community Edition
develop custom Alfresco repository services or extensions
use Alfresco REST API and CMIS implementations
run a local Tomcat or Docker dev environment for Alfresco
contribute to open source enterprise content management
manage documents and collaborate on content with Alfresco
how_to_run: Add the org.alfresco Maven dependencies (alfresco-core, alfresco-data-model, alfresco-repository, alfresco-remote-api, content-services-community) to your pom.xml
Add the Alfresco Maven repository to your build configuration
Follow the Development Tomcat Environment guide (linked in README) to run changes in local Tomcat or Docker containers
notable: Split into separate core, data model, repository and remote API libraries published as Maven artifacts
Branch per ACS release (e.g. release/6.2.2) with hot fixes, plus .N branches for service pack fixes
Includes OpenCMIS implementations and V1 REST API WebScripts
Artifact version numbers do not match the ACS product version for historic reasons
caveats: SNAPSHOT versions of the artifacts are not published
README gives only brief setup guidance and defers development environment details to a separate page
